Building and tuning the code around the model: the loop, tools, permissions, checks and limits.
The harness a vendor ships with its model product, with its own loop, tools and limits.
The harness you add around a model product or API: your loop, your tools and your checks.
A process runs the same steps each time. A model writes different text each run, so the harness must check its output.
front: Where does the operating-system picture of an agent break down?

back: A library of ready-made parts for building a harness. It does not decide your harness for you.
